macros.HELLO_WORLD: Run the pilot's hello_world shell command, which prints a test message. It performs no printer motion or heater action.
macros.BELT_RESONANCES: Home through the canonical sensorless sequence, measure accelerometer noise, collect the two CoreXY belt-direction raw datasets and synchronously generate scripts/outputs/belt_resonances.png. It does not calibrate or save input-shaper settings.
macros.AUTO_CALIBRATE: Home through the canonical sensorless sequence, measure accelerometer noise, calibrate both input-shaper axes under the fixed auto_calibrate run name and synchronously generate scripts/outputs/input_shaper_x.png and input_shaper_y.png. SHAPER_CALIBRATE applies the recommendations for the session; this macro does not issue SAVE_CONFIG.
macros._PILOT_SETTINGS: Stores shared preparation settings. The tap-validation flag currently defaults true in the candidate configuration, but that configured assertion is not itself evidence that physical commissioning passed. The remaining values are restart defaults, and this macro itself issues no commands.
macros.EDDY_INITIAL_SETUP: Bootstrap helper for an uncalibrated Eddy probe only. It refuses loaded or pending calibration, repeated use, printing/paused states, unhomed XY, or missing manual-position confirmation. It assigns a temporary Z coordinate and starts native calibration; it does not measure that temporary height or save automatically.
macros.START_PRINT: Checks filament presence even while idle runout handling is disabled, checks commissioning and interprets HEATSOAK as a nonnegative duration in minutes before preparation; zero skips soaking and omission uses the configured fallback. After the preflight gates pass it enables native filament runout handling for the print. This duration-valued behavior is deployed fleet-wide: for example, HEATSOAK=30 requests a 30-minute soak, not a boolean enable that substitutes another duration. It sets the LCD orange, resets speed/flow overrides, then orchestrates home, bed heating, the requested visible soak, native QGL, Z re-home, cleaning, measured tap reference, scan mesh, final heating at the front-left purge start and purging. It sets the LCD blue only after the purge succeeds. It does not prime before cleaning/tap.
macros._HEAT_SOAK: Requires a positive duration in minutes, announces the start and completion on the LCD and console, and blocks for the corresponding integer number of milliseconds. It does not set or monitor heater targets; START_PRINT calls it only after M190 reaches the requested bed temperature.
macros._HEAT_AT_PURGE_START: After mesh generation, requires homed axes and a valid extrusion temperature, raises to at least Z5 using freshly evaluated position state, moves to nozzle X0.5 Y0.5, then waits for final nozzle temperature. This keeps heating drool at the purge-line start rather than the mesh endpoint.
macros._PURGE_LINE: Final pre-print purge: prime 15mm at front-left Z5, then deposit 39.9mm across two 100mm strokes at Z0.6. Return to Z5 and restore incoming G-code modes without returning to the original location. Requires homing, a hot nozzle, no pause and filament present when its sensor is enabled. Physical clearance/volume validation remains pending.
macros.PREPARE_QGL: Standalone heated leveling shortcut for G34 and the LCD. It heats the bed, homes, levels and re-homes Z. START_PRINT uses native QGL directly because it already owns those preparation steps. All supplied QGL options except BED_TEMP pass through.
macros.GENERATE_PRINT_MESH: Standalone mesh helper: require homing, clear the previous mesh and call native calibration, defaulting to scan. It does not heat, home or level the gantry. ADAPTIVE and other options pass through; START_PRINT separately requests ADAPTIVE=1.
macros.G34: Convenience alias for PREPARE_QGL; forwards all original arguments.
macros._CHECK_TAP_READY: Checks the print commissioning flag, positive native tap threshold, enabled kinematic command, a tap temperature above zero and at most 150C, and a mesh reference at 175,175. Standalone commissioning skips only the flag with REQUIRE_VALIDATED=0. These checks do not prove physical acceptance.
macros.TAP_REFERENCE: For a previously cleaned nozzle, require ready configuration, homed XYZ, completed QGL, no pause/mesh/coordinate shift. Raise and wait at tap temperature without changing XY, then move to nozzle X175 Y175 Z10, sample and apply the measured reference. During START_PRINT this cools above the brush instead of over bed center. Leaves absolute XYZ mode, tap temperature and Z10; does not heat for extrusion or save calibration. Standalone use permits supervised commissioning while START_PRINT remains gated.
macros._disable_filament_sensor_at_ready: One tenth of a second after Klipper becomes ready, disable filament-sensor event handling during idle activity. The sensor continues reporting filament presence, START_PRINT validates that reading and enables native runout handling only after its preflight checks pass.
macros._FILAMENT_CHANGE: Stores whether the automatic M600 unload has completed. The empty command body does not change that state by itself.
macros._RESET_FILAMENT_CHANGE: Clears the completed-change and pending-load flags, restores the ordinary 1mm pause retract and keeps Mainsail's generic cancel retract disabled because the SV08 cleanup hook owns cancellation retraction. Used after resume, end or cancel.
macros._FILAMENT_CHANGE_UNLOAD: Requires a hot paused printer, retracts 53mm, completes the moves, and releases only E for manual feeding/purging. Records completion and suppresses a second unload on cancel. Leaves nozzle heating and XYZ holding intact.
macros.RELEASE_EXTRUDER: Waits for queued moves, then releases only the extruder motor for manual handling. Rejects an actively printing, unpaused machine. It does not heat or move filament.
macros.LOAD_FILAMENT: Reject a second pending load, remember the incoming nozzle target, and heat only when extrusion is currently unsafe. It performs no filament movement. After heating, a separate helper records the prior target and asks the operator to load and purge manually before confirming.
macros.UNLOAD_FILAMENT: Heats first, then calls a separate unload macro. This standalone unload pattern differs from M600's direct 53mm withdrawal.
macros._FILAMENT_HEAT: Rejects active printing and invalid configured loading temperature. Always sets and waits for the configured loading temperature (240C by default), including from 175C pause standby or while cooling from a hotter nozzle. Callers proceed to unloading or the manual-load confirmation prompt only after the wait completes.
macros._LOAD_FILAMENT_MOVES: Requires a hot nozzle, feeds 75mm then 30mm, retracts 2mm, restores modes and releases E. It does not change the heater target; LOAD_FILAMENT restores the target that preceded the overall operation.
macros._FILAMENT_LOAD: Stores whether manual loading awaits confirmation and the nozzle target that must be restored afterward. Its empty command body has no immediate heater or motion effect.
macros._BEGIN_FILAMENT_LOAD: After any required heating completes, mark manual loading active, store the incoming nozzle target, and show instructions with confirm and cancel actions. It performs no extrusion and leaves the loading temperature active pending a response.
macros.CONFIRM_FILAMENT_LOADED: Require an active loading operation and, when enabled, positive filament-sensor detection. A missing filament signal leaves heating and pause intact. Successful confirmation restores the prior nozzle target, clears loading state and tells the operator to resume.
macros.CANCEL_FILAMENT_LOAD: If manual loading is active, restore its saved nozzle target and clear the pending state. Close the client prompt and report cancellation. It does not resume the print or move filament.
macros._UNLOAD_FILAMENT_MOVES: Feeds 25mm, retracts 10mm and 20mm, waits three seconds, then retracts another 50mm. Restores modes and releases E. Keeps heating only if paused.
macros._CLIENT_VARIABLE: Supplies Mainsail's supported parking, pause retraction, sensor, timeout and hooks. The pause hook defers temperature restoration and sets the LCD yellow. Generic cancel retraction and parking are disabled because the SV08 cancel hook owns both. The empty body has no immediate action; Mainsail reads these variables when its macros run.
macros._SV_PAUSE_SETUP: Mainsail calls this after saving the nozzle target and entering pause. Preserve that temperature value while disabling Mainsail's early restoration flag, so the sensor-first resume hook owns reheating, then set the LCD yellow.
macros._SV_RESUME_CHECK: Mainsail resume hook: reject missing pause, lost homing, absent filament or an unconfirmed Load Filament operation before heating. Validate and wait for the saved pre-pause nozzle target. After M600, enable E, add 2mm and reset change state; Mainsail then adds its ordinary 1mm for a total 3mm prime. A successful check sets the LCD blue before return motion.
macros._SV_CANCEL_CLEANUP: Mainsail calls this after disabling its generic retract and switching heater targets off. It disables filament runout event handling for subsequent idle motion, sets the LCD red, waits for queued motion, performs the same guarded 15mm hot retract as END_PRINT unless M600 already unloaded, parks if homed, stops part/exhaust fans, clears mesh and filament-change state, then disables motors. Virtual-SD errors route through cancellation and therefore also set red when Klipper can still execute macros.
macros._IDLE_TIMEOUT: After the extended pause timeout, keep the bed target and all motors energized, reduce only the nozzle target to 175C, and report standby status. The pause hook retained the pre-pause nozzle target, and the sensor-first resume hook waits for it before prime and return motion. When not paused, shut down all heaters and motors normally. The timeout duration is configured elsewhere, not in this macro.
macros.M600: Rejects repeated changes and unhomed use. Suppresses the ordinary pause retract when it owns the pause, pauses/parks if not already paused, heats, then unloads and releases E. The filament sensor automatically calls it after its runout pause; the operator then uses Load Filament before RESUME.
macros.END_PRINT: Disables filament runout event handling before terminal motion. When not already unloaded by M600, it retracts 15mm if hot, parks when homed, shuts down heaters/fans, clears print-related states and disables motors. It restores normal speed and extrusion multipliers, then runs the exhaust at full speed and schedules it to stop after 600 seconds without blocking the green LCD completion state or completion message.
macros._END_PRINT_EXHAUST_OFF: Stops the exhaust fan when Klipper invokes this callback 600 seconds after END_PRINT schedules it. The delayed callback does not change the part-cooling, hotend or electronics fans.
macros._END_PRINT_PARK: If XYZ is homed, raise up to 25mm without exceeding the configured Z ceiling, then move to X0 Y360. If not homed, emit no motion. It leaves XYZ in absolute mode.
macros.HOME_ALL: Clear mesh, home and retreat Y, home and retreat X, then home Z through native safe_z_home. Each XY helper waits for stall detection to clear. This is not a tap wrapper.
macros._HOME_Y_SENSORLESS: Wait two seconds, home Y to its positive endstop and retreat to Y360 at 20mm/s. Wait for retreat motion to finish before returning.
macros._HOME_X_SENSORLESS: Wait two seconds, home X to its positive endstop and retreat to X348 at 20mm/s. Wait for retreat motion to finish before returning.
macros._REQUIRE_HOMED: Abort unless all XYZ axes are homed. Does not home or move the printer itself.
macros.CENTER: Require homing and move the nozzle to X175 Y175, preserving the caller's G-code modes. It does not change Z or return to the original XY position.
macros.CLEAN_NOZZLE: Requires homing, heats for cleaning and follows the stored brush coordinates. It has no filament extrusion or unretraction, no homing, no QGL and no mesh/tap operation. Restores fan speed and G-code modes; leaves the nozzle raised. Coordinates require physical clearance checks.
macros.MULTI_PID_CALIBRATE: Homes, raises Z to 150mm, tunes nozzle PID and bed PID, and optionally saves/restarts. SAVE defaults to yes, so ordinary invocation requests persistence. This is a calibration action, not a print-start requirement.
macros.MAINLED_ON: Set the main LED white channel to full brightness.
macros.MAINLED_OFF: Set the main LED white channel to zero brightness.
macros.MAINLED_TOG: Read the LED white channel; any nonzero brightness becomes off and zero becomes full brightness. SYNC=0 avoids waiting for queued toolhead moves.
macros._ALL_FAN_OFF: Stop the part-cooling fan and the named exhaust fan. Does not disable automatically controlled hotend or electronics fans.
macros.BEEP: Switch the beeper pin on for 10 milliseconds, then off.
macros._LCD_STATUS_PREHEATING: Set all three LCD NeoPixels to orange immediately without synchronizing to queued toolhead motion.
macros._LCD_STATUS_PRINTING: Set all three LCD NeoPixels to blue immediately without synchronizing to queued toolhead motion.
macros._LCD_STATUS_PAUSED: Set all three LCD NeoPixels to yellow immediately without synchronizing to queued toolhead motion. Mainsail invokes this for ordinary pauses, runout pauses and M600.
macros._LCD_STATUS_COMPLETE: Set all three LCD NeoPixels to green immediately without synchronizing to queued toolhead motion after successful END_PRINT cleanup.
macros._LCD_STATUS_ERROR: Set all three LCD NeoPixels to red immediately without synchronizing to queued toolhead motion when cancel cleanup begins.
macros._QUERY_BME280: Optional sensor-reporting helper in the inactive pico configuration. Reads temperature, pressure and humidity and prints them; it does not control heating.
macros.CANCEL_PRINT: Mainsail's cancellation wrapper: optionally park, retract if hot, shut off heaters and call the configured cleanup hook, then cancel the underlying print. In this pilot park_at_cancel is false and cleanup owns parking; cancel_retract is normally 15mm and becomes zero after an M600 unload.
macros.PAUSE: Mainsail's pause wrapper: save nozzle target/timeout information, invoke the underlying pause, run an optional user hook and park. The pilot normally retracts 1mm; M600 temporarily suppresses that retract before its own unload.
macros.RESUME: Unmodified Mainsail resume wrapper: handle its configured restoration policy, require an acceptable filament-sensor state, run the configured resume hook, prime and invoke the underlying resume. The pilot pause hook disables Mainsail's early temperature restoration while retaining its saved target, and the pilot resume hook performs sensor-first reheating and M600-specific behavior.
macros.SET_PAUSE_NEXT_LAYER: Store whether the next layer update should pause, and which macro to invoke. It schedules behavior through SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO; it does not immediately pause.
macros.SET_PAUSE_AT_LAYER: Store an enabled flag, layer number and selected pause macro for a future layer update.
macros.SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO: Intercept layer updates to run a requested next-layer or numbered-layer pause, clear that one-shot request, then forward the original layer information to Klipper.
macros._TOOLHEAD_PARK_PAUSE_CANCEL: Retract through the client helper, then lift and move XY only if homed. Destination uses command overrides first, then client settings, then generic printer defaults. Restore relative XYZ mode if needed. This helper does not itself pause, shut down or release E.
macros._CLIENT_EXTRUDE: If an active extruder is hot enough, perform the requested filament movement using firmware retraction or relative E moves. Restore absolute E mode when necessary. Otherwise report that extrusion is unavailable.
macros._CLIENT_RETRACT: Convert the requested retract length to a negative magnitude and delegate to _CLIENT_EXTRUDE, which checks temperature. SPEED arguments use mm/s here, converted by that helper to G-code feed rate.
macros._CLIENT_LINEAR_MOVE: Build optional axis/feed arguments and perform a linear move inside saved/restored G-code state. It does not independently verify homing or temperature.
macros.GET_TIMELAPSE_SETUP: Assemble and print current timelapse settings. This changes no printer motion or heater state.
macros._SET_TIMELAPSE_SETUP: Validate supplied timelapse options, derive park coordinates and update TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME variables. Select the renamed native pause/resume commands when available so camera parking can bypass operator filament-change handling.
macros.TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME: When enabled and in the appropriate normal/hyperlapse mode, optionally retract and park, save movement state, request a camera frame and schedule completion checks. Remote callbacks and runtime setup determine actual operation; source defaults alone do not show that timelapse is enabled.
macros._TIMELAPSE_NEW_FRAME: Request a frame from Moonraker in a separate template evaluation, passing the current park settings and hyperlapse flag.
macros._WAIT_TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME: Delayed completion check. Reschedule while a frame is pending; otherwise resume through the selected command, restore filament and movement settings, and clear the camera-pause flag.
macros.HYPERLAPSE: Start or stop timer-based camera capture. Start stores the interval, schedules the next frame and immediately requests a frame; stop cancels the scheduled loop.
macros._HYPERLAPSE_LOOP: Schedule the next timer tick and request another hyperlapse frame. Repeats only while scheduling remains enabled.
macros.TIMELAPSE_RENDER: Ask Moonraker to render the video, mark rendering pending, pause through the original command and schedule a completion check.
macros._WAIT_TIMELAPSE_RENDER: While rendering is pending, animate the display and check again after half a second. When the remote client clears the flag, clear the display and invoke the original resume command.
macros.TEST_STREAM_DELAY: If the recorded toolhead Z is above 5mm, move across X, wait the configured park delay and request a frame. Otherwise abort. Used to inspect camera latency; it is not a physical clearance validation.

commands.SET_GCODE_OFFSET: Set a virtual coordinate offset for the specified axes. MOVE=0 or omitted changes the reference without moving; MOVE=1 also applies the offset change as motion. Z=0 clears the user Z offset, not the Eddy calibration.
commands.G90: Use absolute XYZ coordinates for following moves. This does not move the printer or independently change M82/M83.
commands.G91: Use relative coordinates for following moves; in Klipper this also makes E moves relative while G91 remains active.
commands.M82: Use absolute E positions when XYZ is also absolute.
commands.M83: Use relative filament distances for subsequent E moves.
commands.M400: Wait until queued movement has completed before continuing.
commands.M84: Disable all stepper motors, including the extruder; XYZ position can no longer be trusted as homed.
commands.M18: Disable all stepper motors, including the extruder.
commands.M117: Set the printer/LCD status message to the following text; an empty message clears it.
commands.RESPOND: Send the specified message or UI action to the console/client. TYPE selects normal, error or command output.
commands.M118: Write the following text to the console.
commands.M106: Set part-cooling fan duty using S on a 0..255 scale (zero off, 255 full). This does not control the separate exhaust fan.
commands.SET_FAN_SPEED: Set the named generic fan to SPEED on a 0..1 scale; zero is off and one is full duty.
commands.SET_LED: Set the named LED channel brightness on a 0..1 scale. WHITE selects the white channel. SYNC=0 applies without synchronizing to queued motion; otherwise synchronization is enabled by default.
commands.SET_PIN: Set the named output pin to VALUE; this is used for the beeper, not the main LED object.
commands.SAVE_GCODE_STATE: Save the current coordinate modes, offsets, E accounting, feed rate and multipliers under NAME. Does not save a printer calibration or move anything.
commands.G92: Assign the displayed G-code coordinate for the specified axes without moving. E0 resets filament accounting, not physical filament position.
commands.M220: Set the movement feed-rate multiplier to S percent; 100 restores normal speed.
commands.M221: Set the extrusion multiplier to S percent; 100 restores normal filament flow.
commands.BED_MESH_CLEAR: Remove the currently applied bed mesh from movement compensation; do not erase saved profiles.
commands.BED_MESH_CALIBRATE: Measure a new mesh using the shown method/options. METHOD=scan measures while traversing the bed; ADAPTIVE=1 uses available object bounds, while ADAPTIVE=0 requests the configured full area.
commands.QUAD_GANTRY_LEVEL: Measure the configured four gantry points and adjust Z motors to level the gantry. This native call does not implicitly heat or run the project's preparation helper.
commands.TURN_OFF_HEATERS: Set all heater targets to zero. Actual temperatures fall gradually; motors and fans are not disabled by this command.
commands.CLEAR_PAUSE: Clear Klipper's paused state; it does not restore position or resume extrusion.
commands.SET_IDLE_TIMEOUT: Set the inactivity timeout to TIMEOUT seconds for this session; the configured idle handler decides what happens when it expires.
commands.SET_FILAMENT_SENSOR: Enable or disable event handling for the named filament sensor. Detection status continues updating while disabled; this project disables events while idle and enables them only for a validated print lifecycle.
commands.SET_KINEMATIC_POSITION: Assign the requested machine position without moving. Initial setup uses SET_HOMED=Z; measured tap reference uses an empty SET_HOMED= to preserve all homing flags and changes only Z. The user authorized these two guarded uses only.
commands.PROBE: Run a native probe measurement. Here METHOD=tap takes three nozzle-contact samples, retracting 5mm between samples; reject spread over 0.025mm with no automatic tolerance retries. A following macro reads the completed result; this command alone does not establish a new Z reference.
commands.PROBE_EDDY_CURRENT_CALIBRATE: Start native Eddy frequency-to-height calibration for CHIP. Follow the manual calibration procedure; results need SAVE_CONFIG to persist.
commands.TESTZ: Move Z within an active native manual-probe session by the requested numeric delta. The LCD input starts at the probe's reported Z position, ignores its initial zero-delta change event, and converts subsequent encoder-selected absolute positions into relative TESTZ moves.
commands.ACCEPT: Accept the current Z position and finish the active native manual-probe step. During Eddy frequency calibration, Klipper then runs its automatic frequency-to-height measurements; SAVE_CONFIG remains separate.
commands.ABORT: Cancel the active native manual-probe session without accepting its current Z position.
commands.PID_CALIBRATE: Run heater PID tuning for HEATER at TARGET temperature. Results are machine-specific and are not saved merely by issuing this command.
commands.SAVE_CONFIG: Persist pending calibration/configuration results and restart Klipper; this interrupts normal operation.
commands.SHAPER_CALIBRATE: Measure resonance and calculate input-shaper settings. Requires a working accelerometer and suitable homed/clear geometry; saving is separate.
commands.TEST_RESONANCES: Run a resonance test for the selected AXIS; this generates measurement data rather than directly choosing production limits.
commands.MEASURE_AXES_NOISE: Measure accelerometer noise before resonance testing.
commands.G10: Request firmware retraction; requires the firmware_retraction module.
commands.G11: Request firmware unretraction; requires the firmware_retraction module.
commands.M24: Start or resume virtual SD printing through the native SD command.
commands.M25: Pause virtual SD printing through the native SD command.
commands.M26: Set the virtual SD file position using S; zero rewinds to the beginning.
commands.NETWORK_STATUS_REFRESH: Ask the project's network_status extension to refresh network information. The extension implementation is external to these config files; this command alone does not prove its network behavior.
commands.PROBE_EDDY_CURRENT_TAP_CALIBRATE: Run the native Eddy tap-threshold calibration tool with TAP=guess, refine, or verify. Requires a manually prepared clean/cool nozzle near bed center, 3-10mm above the bed. Guess estimates an initial threshold, refine tunes it, and verify checks repeatability. Save accepted calibration separately with SAVE_CONFIG; results are machine-specific.

variables.tap_validated: operator commissioning flag; not a measured validation result
variables.tap_temperature: intended tap nozzle temperature in degrees Celsius
variables.load_temperature: fallback filament-loading nozzle temperature in degrees Celsius
variables.active: whether M600 automatic unloading has completed
variables.started: whether initial Eddy setup has already started this session
variables.retract: ordinary parking retract distance in filament millimeters
variables.unretract: ordinary resume prime distance in filament millimeters
variables.cancel_retract: cancellation retract distance in filament millimeters
variables.custom_park_x: pause parking X position in millimeters
variables.custom_park_y: pause parking Y position in millimeters
variables.speed_move: parking travel speed in millimeters per second
variables.runout_sensor: sensor object used to gate resume
variables.user_resume_macro: helper called by Mainsail immediately before its resume extrusion
variables.user_cancel_macro: helper called after Mainsail switches heaters off
variables.park_at_cancel: whether Mainsail's own cancel parking helper runs
variables.use_custom_pos: whether client coordinates replace generic pause parking defaults
variables.takingframe: whether the remote camera frame is still pending
variables.render: whether the remote video render is still pending
variables.check_time: camera completion polling interval in seconds
variables.last_extruder_temp: saved nozzle-target restoration policy and temperature

lines.RUN_SHELL_COMMAND CMD=hello_world: Invoke the configured hello_world host command, which only prints a test message.
lines.RUN_SHELL_COMMAND CMD=generate_belt_reso: Run the configured host-side plotting script after both belt measurements finish. It writes scripts/outputs/belt_resonances.png and blocks this LCD action until the command finishes or reaches its 120-second timeout.
lines.RUN_SHELL_COMMAND CMD=generate_input_sha: Run the configured host-side input-shaper plotting script after both axis calibrations finish. It writes scripts/outputs/input_shaper_x.png and input_shaper_y.png, blocking until completion or the 120-second timeout.
lines.{% set corrected_z = position.z - result: Subtract the measured bed-reference Z from the current machine Z. For example, current Z5.2 and bed Z0.2 become Z5.0; this relabels the current height without moving the nozzle to the bed.
lines.{% set result = printer.probe.last_probe: Read the completed native PROBE result in machine coordinates. The preceding helper runs after tapping; the native result already includes tap_z_offset.
lines.{% if not (-1 <= result.z <= 1) %}: Reject a correction outside minus one to plus one millimeter, including non-finite values. This project-selected bound catches surprising results after probing; it cannot prevent a physical contact failure.
lines.{% if params.REQUIRE_VALIDATED|default(1: Require the operator acceptance flag for normal print startup. Standalone commissioning explicitly skips this flag, while retaining the remaining configuration and motion checks.
lines.{% set z_park = [[(act.z + park_dz), z_m: Calculate the parking height: take the higher of current Z plus the lift and requested Z_MIN, then cap it at the machine's maximum Z corrected for the current offset.
lines.{% set pending = cf.save_config_pending_: Read pending unsaved changes for the Eddy section. Use an empty dictionary if none exists or the section is marked for removal.
lines.{% if section not in cf.config or cf.sav: Check whether Eddy configuration or pending-save status is unavailable. If either is missing, enter the following error branch rather than assume the probe is uncalibrated.
lines.{% if 'calibrate' in cf.config[section]: If a frequency-height calibration key exists in loaded config or pending saves, reject bootstrap setup. Presence is enough; the value is not used to decide this guard.
lines.{% if sensor.enabled and not sensor.fila: If filament monitoring is enabled but no filament is detected, enter the error branch. A deliberately disabled sensor does not block this resume or confirmation check.
lines.{% if not sensor.filament_detected %}: Reject print startup whenever filament is absent, including while idle runout event handling is deliberately disabled.
lines.{% set target = printer.extruder.target: Choose the existing nozzle target when paused and that target is above the extrusion minimum; otherwise choose the configured loading temperature.
lines.{% if not printer['gcode_macro _PILOT_SE: If the operator commissioning flag is false, enter the branch that blocks print preparation. A true flag is only a configured assertion, not measured proof.
lines.{% if 'tap_threshold' not in printer.con: Check for a missing native Eddy tap threshold in loaded settings; the following error branch rejects an unconfigured tap path.
lines.{% if 'xyz' not in printer.toolhead.home: Reject the operation if any XYZ axis is unhomed or the nozzle is too cold for extrusion.
lines.{% if printer['gcode_macro _FILAMENT_CHA: Select the filament-change branch only after the M600 unload helper has recorded completion.
lines.{% if not printer['gcode_macro _FILAMENT: Select this branch when an M600 unload has not already completed, avoiding an additional end-of-print retract after unloading.
lines.{% if not printer.pause_resume.is_paused: Reject unloading unless the printer is paused and the nozzle is hot enough to extrude.
lines.{% set ri = printer['gcode_macro TIMELAP: Reduce the render animation counter to one of four positions, selecting the next spinner character.
lines.{% if tl.takingframe %}: If the remote camera request is still pending, take the branch that schedules another completion check.
lines.{% if printer['gcode_macro TIMELAPSE_REN: If the remote client still marks video rendering as pending, update the display and schedule another check.
lines.{% set _dummy = tl.macro.update({'pause': Store the original pause command's alias in the timelapse settings, so camera pauses bypass the user-facing PAUSE wrapper.
lines.{% set _dummy = tl.macro.update({'resume: Store the original resume command's alias in the timelapse settings, so camera resumes bypass the user-facing RESUME wrapper.
lines.{% set use_fw_retract = (client.use_fw_r: Use firmware retraction only if the client requests it and the firmware_retraction module actually exists; otherwise use explicit E moves.
lines.{% set x_park = params.X if params: Begin choosing the parking X coordinate. An explicit X argument takes priority; the following lines supply custom-client or generic-printer fallbacks.
lines.{% set y_park = params.Y if params: Begin choosing the parking Y coordinate. An explicit Y argument takes priority; the following lines supply custom-client or generic-printer fallbacks.
